issues.concern: The gloss for sense 2 is misleading. 'to nod (when vertical)' implies that '首を振る' itself means 'to nod' when modified by '縦に', but the base phrase '首を振る' does not mean 'to nod'. It means 'to shake one's head'. The '縦に' part is crucial for it to mean 'nod'.
issues.suggestion: Change to 'to nod (when specified as vertical movement)' or similar, to clarify that '首を振る' alone doesn't mean 'nod'.
